title: The Mammoth Calf
text: A mammoth calf is lost in the snow, its red fur caked with ice, crying for its mother in long, sad bellows. It is as big as a horse and still a baby. In the distance the ground shakes, then shakes again, closer.

options.label: Lead the calf toward the shaking, trusting its mother to understand.

outcomes.text: Its mother finds it, and lets you walk in the shelter of her bulk.
Its mother finds you first, and she does not see a rescue.

options.label: Hide in the snow until they pass, keeping very still.

outcomes.text: A whole herd goes by. The wait is long and freezing, and your kit is stiff with ice by the end.

options.label: The shrewdest says a calf's tusks fetch a price while the herd is still far off.

outcomes.text: They do fetch a price. The herd hears the calf stop crying, and the herd remembers.
